environment_degradation: WebFetch returned DNS-level ENOTFOUND for the large majority of external domains this run (openai.com, blog.google, ai.meta.com, x.ai, mistral.ai, api-docs.deepseek.com, hn.algolia.com, smol.ai, tldr.tech, simonwillison.net, youtube.com, latent.space, explainx.ai, podwise.ai, en.wikipedia.org), while github.com resolved fine. This is broader than the previously documented youtube.com-only block — it affected roughly 2/3+ of attempted sources, well over the 1/3 threshold for flagging environment degradation. WebSearch was the only working discovery channel; expert_content ended up empty this run because no candidate could be verified against a readable primary source within the 7-day window.
